parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A wheel of the cart made of rubber, typically circular and attached to the base frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body and frame of the cart made of steel, including the basket and handle.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the items placed in the cart and provides structural support for the wheels and handle.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheels but can be pushed or pulled as a whole unit.
